instruction: Please configure VS Code to set the rulers at column 80 for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VS Code rulers setting to [80]. Evaluator checks the settings.json file for the correct key-value pair. Uses existing check_json_settings metric which handles array values.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to set VS Code rulers at column 80
The result getter (get_vm_file) extracts the correct file (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
The metric (check_json_settings) correctly compares expected key-value pairs, including array values
Expected value {"editor.rulers": [80]} is semantically correct for VS Code ruler configuration
Data flow is correct: file extraction -> JSON parsing -> key-value comparison
No postconfig needed as VS Code settings.json is automatically persisted
Metric handles edge cases: missing files, JSON parse errors, and missing keys correctly
